Amy plays badminton with Grace every Sunday. Amy and Grace had great fun there. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Also, the priest greeted every parishioner after the Sunday service.

Amy thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike. The airport is one of the best places in the city. The successful businesswoman flies to meetings around the world.
Both of them like salad and juice. They took many photos at the bus stop. Amy is going to travel to Rome in April. The nurse took a small sample of my blood.
Amy drinks juice after doing sports. Grace is interested in drawing. Life is full of small surprises.
